items.html: And the discerning will understand from this what is written, that every emergence of renewed lights and additional worlds comes about only through a restriction of light. For so was the restriction of Ein Sof in order to bring out AK, and of AK in order to bring out the Nekudim, which is Atzilut. And all this is close to the annulment of the kings, and it is forbidden to utter it with the mouth, for this is an exalted place.
